text:
A person holds an empty glass beaker and pours hot water into it.
Why does it take a few seconds before his hand starts to feel hot?
A
Glass is a poor conductor of heat.
B
Water is a poor conductor of heat.
C
Glass is a better conductor of heat than water.
D
Water is a better conductor of heat than glass.

options.label: A
options.text: Glass is a poor conductor of heat.

options.label: B
options.text: Water is a poor conductor of heat.

options.label: C
options.text: Glass is a better conductor of heat than water.

options.label: D
options.text: Water is a better conductor of heat than glass.
